cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I know this board game. I'm opening with the horse in the lake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. I'm testing the scoring environment first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We have established a stable scoring environment.

mechanism: A casts each rule correction from its board-game pupil as progress in A own tutorial, improvising a new authoritative move around it.
confusable: Not truly teaching a known rule set: B exposes A mistaken pieces and prohibited move, while A maintains mastery through fresh invented rationale.
comparison: Game-piece misunderstanding versus shifting raffle odds tactic.
seedUse: D210 horse/lake/scoring marker/cannot move/stability; S05 taught checking board.
